artworks.title: Mon Dieu! Monseigneur, je suis...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a room. The first person is on the left, holding a hat and leaning forward. The second person is in the center, seated with hands on their lap. The third person is on the right, seated with legs crossed. The background includes a decorated wall, an artwork or window, and a decorative piece on the left side.

artworks.title: Robert Macaire commissionnaire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures facing each other in profile. The figure on the left has a slumped posture, curly hair, and is dressed in a dark overcoat over a lighter shirt and trousers. The figure on the right stands more upright, with short hair, sharp facial features, and is wearing a top hat, waistcoat, and striped trousers. The background includes a window with "CAISSE" written on it, and a sign on the wall stating "ROBERT MACAIRE ET CIE COMMISSIONNAIRES."

artworks.title: Robert Macaire Directeur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in conversation in a newspaper office. One man is standing, leaning on a counter, while the other is behind the counter. The background features shelves with stacks of papers or books. The standing man is gesturing while speaking, and the man behind the counter appears attentive. The drawing uses shades of gray and detailed line work for depth and texture. The overall tone is satirical, possibly depicting a negotiation or transaction in a publishing or journalistic setting. The figures have exaggerated features, emphasizing the comedic or critical tone of the piece.

artworks.title: Triomphe de la probité politique commerciale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration of a crowd scene. In the middle, there is a figure on a raised platform, interacting with surrounding individuals. The crowd is dynamic, with various people wearing top hats and gesturing towards the central figure. The drawing is done in a detailed style, capturing the lively atmosphere of the gathering. The composition and expressions in the image hint at a satirical or caricature style, possibly reflecting on a political or social theme.

artworks.title: Mon cher ami, je vous présent Monsieur...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of three individuals from the waist up. The central person stands straight, wearing a tall top hat and a coat with a visible clasp. They have distinct facial features including a pronounced nose and round spectacles, with neat, short hair. To their left, another person leans towards them in a side profile, with sharp facial features and long hair falling around their shoulders, dressed in a garment with a high collar. On the right, a third person is leaning closer, with a curly hairstyle shorter on the sides, wearing a high-collared shirt or jacket. This person also has distinct facial features and holds the central person's hand. The background has faint, indistinguishable text, and the bottom of the image includes handwritten script.

artworks.title: Ma soeur disait comme ça, hier, qu'elle vous trouve trop laid!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a sketched, caricature style. The left figure is an elderly man seated on a wooden chair, with his body facing slightly towards the other two figures. His facial features are elongated and pronounced, with a large nose and a prominent chin. His hair is combed back and slightly wavy. He is wearing a high-collared shirt and a jacket. A young child sits on the man's knee, facing him with a laughing expression. The child has a prominent, round forehead and a smoothed, pulled-back hairstyle, wearing what appears to be a simple dress. The third figure, a woman, appears to be seated next to the man, slightly turned away from him. Her features are exaggerated, with a long, oval face and distinctive long ears, with her hair styled in a smooth bun. She is dressed in a flowing, long-sleeved garment. The background of the image is plain and subtly textured with faint, vertically oriented lines or patterns.

artworks.title: La fourmi
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man leaning forward in a walking pose, holding a bag to his chest. He wears a hat with wide brims and two protrusions, a long overcoat, tight trousers, and carries an umbrella and a cane. There is a building labeled "CAISSE D'EPARGNE" in the background with a crowd gathered around it. The artist's signature "h. Daumier" is visible at the bottom left. The drawing is set against a textured paper background.

artworks.title: Le Crocodile
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white drawing of a man in attire like a top hat and coat looking at a shop window displaying food items. The window shows various meats and produce, including sausages and a pumpkin. The man has an exaggerated, caricatured expression. The background features a busy street scene with other figures in similar attire. The drawing uses strong lines and shading to create depth and humor.

artworks.title: Un échantillon de ce qu'on appèll...les beaux de paris
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up, facing each other in profile. The man on the left stands with one hand slightly raised. He has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and curly dark hair, wearing a dark coat with a high collar. The man on the right stands with arms crossed over his chest, also having a prominent nose, thin lips, high cheekbones, and neatly combed receding hair. He is dressed in a dark suit, shirt, and tie. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by either man. The background is plain with minimal detail, focusing on the two figures.

artworks.title: Tout est payé? Nous n'avons fait...salut
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. Two characters are in the foreground, while the third person is in the background. The two men in the foreground are standing facing right, with one leaning slightly towards the other. Both have exaggerated, cartoonish facial features with prominent noses, thin lips, short hair, and tall hats. They wear jackets and layered clothing. The man on the right gestures with his hand. The man in the background is seated and facing the foreground men with a surprised or confused expression, having a rounded face, small eyes, and wearing a jacket over a shirt. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The setting includes a counter cluttered with pitcher-like objects and jars, suggesting a shop. The background has textured walls and floors with simple lines. Above the scene, "LA CARICATURE PROVISOIRE" is written.

artworks.title: Le Toucher
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly figure holding a young figure across their lap. The image shows an elderly character with a stern expression, draped in a shawl, clutching twigs. The young figure appears to be attempting to shield themselves. The setting is a domestic interior with simple furnishings; a bottle and bowl sit on a table to the left, and there are various objects on a shelf to the right. A framed silhouette of a figure decorates the wall above. The drawing portrays a tense scene filled with conflict and emotion, depicting rough dynamics and domestic life common in satirical art during this period.

artworks.title: Je suis le plus grand ennemi des factions
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals engaged in a card game at a table. The scene is depicted with exaggerated and satirical facial features. The individual on the left appears to be holding a fan of cards. The others have various expressions, one appearing annoyed or displeased, and the other seemingly deep in concentration. The table is set with a bottle and glasses. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for caricatures critiquing societal behaviors and political scenarios. Deep shadows and simple line work emphasize the lamp-lit ambiance and the group's focus on their card game. The title "Types Parisiens" along with the printed dialogue hints at the humorous or satirical nature of the piece.

artworks.title: Soyez tranquille bourgeois, on connait
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up engaged in conversation. One man gestures at the other. The man on the left holds a stick and has a scruffy beard with textured hair under a hat. He wears a wrinkled jacket over a striped shirt. The man on the right faces left and is well-groomed with a clean-shaven face and a top hat. He wears a long coat and cravat and holds an object resembling a cane or umbrella. The backdrop includes a blurred door frame, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Dire que ça si dandine avec un petit air...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two main characters walking closely together. The man is facing left, wearing a top hat, a fur-collared coat, and striped trousers. He has facial hair and a mustache. The woman is slightly behind and to the left of the man, wearing a bonnet, a dress, and a shawl. A child is to the right of the couple, wearing a top hat, a coat, and carrying a bucket. The child is walking in the opposite direction. In the background, there are indistinct shapes that suggest distant figures or objects. Text is printed lightly in the background.

artworks.title: La plainte en adultère
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene with detailed figures present. In the foreground, there is a figure standing and leaning on a desk, seemingly engaging in discussion with a group of three seated individuals. These seated figures appear to be officials or judges, dressed in traditional robes and hats. Another figure sits facing this scene, appearing attentive. The setting conveys a formal judicial environment. French text is visible at the top and bottom of the page, along with the signature "h.D".

artworks.title: En v'là un petit pochard!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts three adults and one child in an indoor setting. One woman is holding a child and another man is looking at her. The woman is feeding the child while gesturing, and the man is standing with his hand in his pocket. An older person is standing near a counter in the background. The scene is set in a rustic establishment or tavern.

artworks.title: Le mari du bas-bleu...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in a room. The man on the left is holding a swaddled baby, while the man on the right appears to be engaged in conversation. Both men are dressed in clothing typical of the past, with minimal background detail. There is text above and below the image.

artworks.title: J'ai trois sous
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in front of a restaurant window. The person is wearing a tall hat, a dark coat with tails, and matching trousers. The individual has their hands in their pockets. In the background, there are various food items displayed in the restaurant window, which is labeled 'CAFÉ RESTAURANT.' Inside the restaurant, two seated figures are shown conversing at a table under dim lighting.

artworks.title: Ma patrie, a moi?...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three full-length figures. The person on the left is wearing a military uniform with a tall hat, epaulettes, and a sash. They have a mustache and a solemn expression. The central figure has exaggerated features and a hunched posture, wearing a long coat over striped pants. The figure on the right has a bald head with some hair at the back, wearing a light-colored coat and dark pants. The background shows nondescript crosshatching and lines. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Je me dis en moi-même
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing together. The man is standing upright with his left arm bent across his torso, wearing a top hat, a long coat, and a detailed waistcoat. His facial features include a pronounced chin and nose, with sideburns extending from his hat to his cheeks. The woman is standing slightly turned, wearing a large bonnet with ribbons tied under her chin and a decorative flower, her face turned slightly upward. Her hair is styled in curls framing her face. She is dressed in a long skirt with intricate patterns and a shawl draped over her shoulders, holding the edge of the shawl with her right hand. Both figures are against a plain background with faint French text visible in the backdrop.

artworks.title: Mme Greluche: Oh Gustave, qu'elle est bonne!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two adults and a child in water from the chest up. The person on the left is standing holding an umbrella and carrying a child, while the person on the right is holding a dog. The adults wear headscarves and loose clothing suitable for swimming. Items like a hat and shoes float around them. The background shows a minimal shoreline with trees and landscape elements, suggesting a calm day by the water.

artworks.title: Qui aime Bertrand aime son chien
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, seated by a small round table. The woman on the left has a lined face, features, a bonnet tied under her chin, a long dress, and a cloak. The man on the right leans forward with one arm on the table. He has a gaunt face, a beard, a top hat, a jacket, a necktie, a waistcoat, and tight pants. Items on the table include a small dog, a bottle, and two glasses. The background is a plain wall, potentially indicating an indoor setting like a tavern.

artworks.title: Comme on fait son lit on se couche
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One man is on horseback, holding the reins with both hands. He wears a large hat, a long coat, a scarf, gloves, and has short hair. The other man is walking beside the horse, hunched over, holding his jacket closed with his arms crossed. He has a long face, scruffy hair under his wide-brimmed hat, and wears a simple dark outfit with pointed shoes. The background is plain or desert-like, with slightly uneven ground. The image is monochrome with text surrounding it from a publication of proverbs and maxims.

artworks.title: Ce monsieur, au sortier de l'estaminet ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a sofa in a slouched position. They are leaning forward, resting their arms on their knees. The person has a cap on their head, distinctive facial features, and is wearing a loose shirt and dark trousers. One of their shoes is off, next to scattered playing cards, while the other shoe is on. A floating top hat is above their head. The background is simple, with a striped cushion on the sofa. The illustration is sketch-like with fine lines and shading.
